earlierAttempts.diagnosis: Native PostgreSQL volume fixture still used the retired Report workflow; migration 0025 rejected it.

earlierAttempts.step: Install the locked Playwright Chromium and system libraries
earlierAttempts.observed: Ubuntu system-package downloads from azure.archive.ubuntu.com progressed slowly for over ten minutes; fonts-ipafont-gothic was retried. The job was cancelled while downloading dependencies, before lint or application tests.
earlierAttempts.diagnosis: The logs establish a slow package-download stage. The underlying network or mirror cause is unconfirmed; this attempt is not an application-test failure or pass.

failures: The new action is labelled Edit, not Edit Report.
The synthetic harness included a hidden legacy historyTab alongside the actual tab.
Collapsed Worker cards intentionally omit answer content until expanded.
diagnosis.evidence: The Worker API returned corrected answer and revision 2. The unopened card showed Submitted, seven photos and Show details; opening the uniquely owned card revealed the correction.
diagnosis.fix: Updated verifier selectors and expanded the card before checking the corrected answer. No application change was needed.
diagnosis.final: 13 checkpoints passed; two owned Reports, one Template and one Worker cleaned up; no unexpected requests or page errors.

earlierAttempts.detail: The previous release's first fixed-source invitation account-switch timeout remains unexplained despite three isolated passes and a complete frontend rerun.

earlierAttempts.diagnosis: The unchanged runtime image lacked the smoke harness's test-only pypdf reader; the import failure occurred before HTTP checks. A distinct verified job reproduced the missing module, supplied a size/hash-pinned wheel only to the smoke subprocess, and verified disposable fixture cleanup without changing the image.

warnings: warn - Neon history retention is only 6 hours; choose a longer paid window or external logical backups before relying on it for production recovery
Existing frontend main-bundle size advisory remains.
limitations: No authenticated production fixture or physical iOS/Android test was performed for this release.
Hosted browser verification is anonymous shell/install/update/offline verification. Correction and evidence workflows were exercised locally and by isolated provider HTTP staging.
Report corrections require connectivity and have no persistent offline correction draft; invalid or missing original Definition snapshots block saving.
Supervisor cold-offline Template catalogs remain unchanged; an already opened form can queue offline.
Previously queued or emailed PDFs retain their original submission and recipient snapshots. Corrections do not resend them.
Normal scheduled work may send existing pending email. No dedicated real SMTP or mailbox-delivery test was run; accepted/uncertain attempts are never automatically retried.
The historical invitation account-switch CI timeout remains unconfirmed.
Legacy HTML logo packaging remains unchanged; isolated provider smoke supplies the existing repository-logo fixture in its disposable runtime.
Rollback identities and expiry values reflect recorded provider observations and must be reverified before use.
